answer.title: Daily Customer Reminder Calls
answer.trigger: Triggered every working day at 15:30 to prepare the daily reminder call list.
steps: Retrieve today's list of appointments or bookings from the system.
Draft a friendly reminder message or script for each customer.
Queue the outbound phone calls or SMS reminders for Claire to review.
Place the reminder calls using the phone system.
answer.ai_help: AI drafts the reminder messages and organizes the call queue.
answer.human_approval: Claire must approve the call list before dialing starts.
answer.risk_reason: Mistakes would only result in a miscommunicated appointment time, which can be quickly corrected with a follow-up call.
